name: Sasha
source:
Occupation: Drug dealer, lazy punk
Likes: fast food, parties, getting high
Dislikes: Feeling cornered, hearing "no"

Sasha is mostly easygoing, selfish with his needs, paranoid due to his work, and lacks ambition to change his situation. His stubbornness makes him hard to crack and he evades vulnerability altogether. That's part of why he wont explore deeper emotions with Mishka, placing him in closest friend-zone imaginable.
